# NestJS Project — Generated by create-nestkit

This project was scaffolded with `create-nestkit`. The structure, patterns, and conventions below
are exactly how this codebase is built. Follow them strictly when adding any code.

## How to detect active plugins

Check `src/app.module.ts` imports to know which plugins are active in this project:
- `DatabaseModule` → TypeORM + PostgreSQL is active
- `AuthModule` → JWT auth with refresh token rotation is active
- `MailerModule` → email sending via port/adapter is active
- `SocketModule` → WebSockets via Socket.io is active
- `PdfModule` → PDF generation via Puppeteer is active

Only apply patterns for the plugins that are actually imported.

## Available slash commands

- `/nestjs/module <Name>` — generate a complete CRUD module (entity, DTOs, service, controller, exceptions)
- `/nestjs/plugin <Plugin> <Adapter>` — generate a new port/adapter plugin
- `/nestjs/exception <Module> <Type>` — generate a domain exception

---

## Stack

- **NestJS 11** with **TypeORM 0.3** and **PostgreSQL** (`pg` driver)
- **class-validator + class-transformer** for DTOs
- **@nestjs/jwt + passport-jwt** for auth
- **@nestjs/swagger** for API docs
- **Joi** for env validation
- **bcrypt** for password hashing

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── main.ts
├── app.module.ts
├── config/                    # @Global() config module + Joi env validation
├── database/                  # TypeORM setup, base entities, seeds
├── modules/                   # Feature modules (users, roles, auth, health...)
├── plugins/                   # Port & Adapter pattern (mailer, pdf, socket)
└── shared/                    # Cross-cutting: DTOs, filters, ORM utils, decorators
```

## Module Anatomy

Every feature module (`src/modules/{name}/`) contains exactly:

```
{module}/
├── controllers/{module}.controller.ts
├── services/{module}.service.ts
├── dto/
│   ├── {module}.dto.ts                      # Output DTO (@DtoField/@DtoRelation)
│   ├── create-{module}.dto.ts
│   ├── update-{module}.dto.ts
│   ├── find-all-{module}-params.dto.ts      # extends PaginationParamsDto
│   └── find-all-{module}-response.dto.ts    # extends PaginationResponseDto<Dto>
├── entities/{module}.entity.ts
├── exceptions/
│   ├── {module}-not-found.exception.ts
│   ├── {module}-already-exists.exception.ts
│   └── index.ts
└── {module}.module.ts
```

## Entities

Always extend `BaseEntitySoftDelete`. Explicit `name:` on every column. PK is `{entity}_id` in DB, `id` in TS. Table names: snake_case plural.

```typescript
@Entity('products')
export class Product extends BaseEntitySoftDelete {
    @PrimaryGeneratedColumn({ name: 'product_id' })
    id: number;

    @Column({ name: 'name', type: 'varchar', length: 150 })
    name: string;
}
```

Rules: use `softDelete()` never `delete()`. FK columns always have explicit `@JoinColumn({ name: 'fk_id' })`.

---

## DTOs

**Output DTO** — uses `@DtoField()` / `@DtoRelation()` from `src/shared/orm`:
```typescript
export class ProductDto {
    @DtoField() @ApiProperty({ example: 1 })   id!: number;
    @DtoField() @ApiProperty({ example: 'x' }) name!: string;
    @DtoField() @ApiProperty()                 createdAt!: Date;
}
```

**Create DTO** — class-validator with descriptive messages:
```typescript
export class CreateProductDto {
    @ApiProperty({ example: 'Widget', maxLength: 150 })
    @IsString() @IsNotEmpty({ message: 'Name is required.' }) @MaxLength(150)
    name: string;
}
```

**Update DTO** — explicit optional fields, no `PartialType`:
```typescript
export class UpdateProductDto {
    @ApiPropertyOptional() @IsOptional() @IsString() @MaxLength(150)
    name?: string;
}
```

**Query params** — extends `PaginationParamsDto`, `@Type(() => Number)` on numeric filters.

**Response DTO** — extends `PaginationResponseDto<Dto>` with `declare data: ProductDto[]`.

## Exceptions

```typescript
export class ProductNotFoundException extends NotFoundException {
    constructor() {
        super({ message: 'Product not found.', error: 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND' });
    }
}
```

- `message`: human-readable, ends with period
- `error`: `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`
- No constructor params — self-contained
- Always export via `exceptions/index.ts`

## Services

```typescript
@Injectable()
export class ProductsService {
    private readonly repo: DtoRepository<Product>;

    constructor(@InjectRepository(Product) private readonly rawRepo: Repository<Product>) {
        this.repo = new DtoRepository(rawRepo);
    }

    async findAll(params: FindAllProductsParamsDto): Promise<PaginationResponseDto<ProductDto>> {
        return this.repo.findPaginated({ dto: ProductDto, pagination: params, order: { createdAt: 'DESC' } });
    }

    async findOne(id: number, { throwException = true }: FindOptions = {}): Promise<ProductDto | null> {
        const product = await this.repo.findOne({ dto: ProductDto, where: { id } });
        if (!product && throwException) throw new ProductNotFoundException();
        return product;
    }

    async create(dto: CreateProductDto, options?: MutationOptions): Promise<ProductDto> {
        const repo = options?.manager?.getRepository(Product) ?? this.rawRepo;
        const item = repo.create(dto);
        const saved = await repo.save(item);
        return this.findOne(saved.id);
    }

    async update(id: number, dto: UpdateProductDto, options?: MutationOptions): Promise<ProductDto> {
        const repo = options?.manager?.getRepository(Product) ?? this.rawRepo;
        const item = await repo.findOne({ where: { id } });
        if (!item) throw new ProductNotFoundException();
        Object.assign(item, dto);
        await repo.save(item);
        return this.findOne(id);
    }

    async remove(id: number, options?: MutationOptions): Promise<void> {
        const repo = options?.manager?.getRepository(Product) ?? this.rawRepo;
        const item = await repo.findOne({ where: { id } });
        if (!item) throw new ProductNotFoundException();
        await repo.softDelete(id);
    }
}
```

Rules: always wrap `rawRepo` in `DtoRepository`. Public methods return DTOs. `findOne` accepts `{ throwException }`. `create/update/remove` accept `MutationOptions` for transactions.

## Controllers

```typescript
@ApiTags('Products')
@ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
@Controller('products')
export class ProductsController {
    constructor(private readonly productsService: ProductsService) {}

    @Get()    @AdminUp() @ApiOperation({ summary: '...' }) @ApiOkResponse({ type: FindAllProductsResponseDto }) @ApiUnauthorized()
    findAll(@Query() params: FindAllProductsParamsDto) { return this.productsService.findAll(params); }

    @Get(':id') @AdminUp() @ApiOperation({ summary: '...' }) @ApiOkResponse({ type: ProductDto }) @ApiNotFound() @ApiUnauthorized()
    findOne(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) { return this.productsService.findOne(id); }

    @Post() @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED) @AdminUp() @ApiOperation({ summary: '...' }) @ApiCreatedResponse({ type: ProductDto }) @ApiValidationError() @ApiUnauthorized()
    create(@Body() dto: CreateProductDto) { return this.productsService.create(dto); }

    @Put(':id') @AdminUp() @ApiOperation({ summary: '...' }) @ApiOkResponse({ type: ProductDto }) @ApiNotFound() @ApiUnauthorized()
    update(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number, @Body() dto: UpdateProductDto) { return this.productsService.update(id, dto); }

    @Delete(':id') @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT) @AdminUp() @ApiOperation({ summary: '...' }) @ApiNoContentResponse() @ApiNotFound() @ApiUnauthorized()
    remove(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) { return this.productsService.remove(id); }
}
```

Status codes: GET=200, POST=201, PUT=200, DELETE=204. Always `ParseIntPipe` on route params. Swagger shorthand decorators: `@ApiNotFound()`, `@ApiConflict()`, `@ApiUnauthorized()`, `@ApiForbidden()`, `@ApiValidationError()`.

---

## Role Hierarchy

`1=root`, `2=admin`, `3=user`. Check: `user.roleId <= required`. Decorators: `@RootOnly()`, `@AdminUp()`, `@UserUp()`.

---

## Auth (if AuthModule is active)

- `JwtPayload`: `{ sub: number, email: string, roleId: number }`
- `AuthUser`: `{ id: number, email: string, roleId: number }` — what's in `req.user`
- `@Public()` skips JWT check. `@CurrentUser()` gets `req.user`. `@CurrentUser('id')` gets a field.
- Refresh token stored hashed in DB. Rotation on every refresh. Reuse detection revokes all sessions.

## Plugin Pattern (if adding a new plugin)

```
plugins/{plugin}/
├── {plugin}.port.ts       # abstract class
├── {plugin}.module.ts     # @Global() DynamicModule.register()
└── {impl}/
    ├── {impl}.adapter.ts  # extends port
    ├── {impl}.config.ts   # wraps ConfigService
    └── {impl}.module.ts
```

Consumers inject the port, never the adapter.

---

## ORM Utilities (src/shared/orm)

- `DtoRepository<E>` — wraps `Repository<E>`, auto-derives `select` + `relations` from DTO metadata
- `@DtoField()` — marks scalar; applies `@Expose()`
- `@DtoRelation(() => RelatedDto)` — marks relation; applies `@Expose()` + `@Type()`

## Naming Conventions

| Element | Convention | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Files | kebab-case | `product-not-found.exception.ts` |
| Classes | PascalCase + suffix | `ProductsService`, `ProductDto` |
| DB tables | snake_case plural | `products` |
| DB columns | snake_case | `product_id`, `created_at` |
| API routes | kebab-case plural | `/api/products` |
| Error codes | SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE | `PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND` |

---

## General Rules

1. No `PartialType` — write update DTOs explicitly.
2. Always `softDelete()`, never hard delete.
3. Public service methods return DTOs, never raw entities.
4. `@ApiProperty` on every DTO field.
5. Config values always from config service, never hardcoded.
6. Domain exceptions only — never throw plain strings.
7. Check existence before update/delete, throw domain exception if missing.
8. All modules export their service.
9. Every `exceptions/`, `decorators/`, `guards/` folder has `index.ts` barrel.
